title: France vs Spain World Cup semi-final: Mbappe and Yamal predictions
facts: France and Spain were scheduled to play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup semifinals at Dallas Stadium in Arlington, Texas.
France topped Group I in the 2026 World Cup with a perfect record of nine points.
France recorded victories against Norway, Senegal, and Iraq during the 2026 World Cup group stage.
France defeated Morocco 2-0 in the quarterfinals to reach the 2026 World Cup semifinals.
Spain topped Group H in the 2026 World Cup with seven points.
Spain secured a 2-1 victory over Belgium in the quarterfinals of the 2026 World Cup.
Kylian Mbappe led the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot race with eight goals in five games ahead of the semifinal.
France's Ousmane Dembele scored five goals leading up to the 2026 World Cup semifinal match.
Michael Olise recorded five assists for France prior to the 2026 World Cup semifinal.
Kylian Mbappe scored 20 goals in 20 appearances across three separate World Cup tournaments.
The France national team reached four of the last seven World Cup finals prior to 2026.
Luis de la Fuente served as the head coach of the Spain national football team during the 2026 World Cup.
Spain previously defeated France in the semifinals of the Euro 2024 tournament.
Spain and France played each other 38 times prior to their 2026 World Cup semifinal matchup.
Spain defeated France 5-4 in the UEFA Nations League semifinals in 2025.
